about: What this person told voters in each campaign since 2016: their campaign website as saved by the Wayback Machine just before election day (the homepage and the pages about where they stand), as text, and their campaign-season Bluesky and Threads posts. From scripts/collect-campaign-text.mjs; the promises in it are found by step 2.
name: Randy Villegas

posts.text: Bakersfield, I want to hear from you. Join me this Thursday for a town hall focused on the impact of healthcare cuts in our district. RSVP here: mobilize.us/s/Rf3J81

Bakersfield, quiero escucharles. Acompáñenme este jueves en una conversación comunitaria centrada en el impacto de los recortes en el cuidado de salud en nuestro distrito. Confirmen su asistencia aquí: mobilize.us/s/Rf3J81

I'm running as a corporate-free candidate because I'm tired of sell-out politicians. Our campaign is completely funded by people like you. If you're tired too, chip in to help get us Congress. randy.vote 

youtube.com/shorts/DmRd5...

Big news! We're excited to announce that staunch champion for universal healthcare, Rep. @rokhanna.bsky.social will be joining us at our Guaranteed Healthcare Town Hall in Bakersfield this Thursday. We can't wait to hear form you Bakersfield. RSVP here: mobilize.us/s/Rf3J81

Our campaign is powered by volunteers. We need all the people power we can get if we're going to defeat the corporate dollars we're up against. If you believe in a Central Valley that puts people before profits, join us.

Volunteer: www.mobilize.us/randyvillega

I’m running for Congress to be accountable to Central Valley residents, not corporate donors or special interests. I'm proud to have the support of CA Congressman @rokhanna.bsky.social in this race and look forward to joining him in the fight to build a government that puts people before profits.

Central Valley residents have raised concerns about data centers’ impacts on land, water, electricity costs and our communities. I share these concerns. That's why I support a moratorium on new data centers while Congress sets new standards that put working families first.

Did you know that there are more animals than people in California's Central Valley? Naturally, we've recruited them into the campaign. Now we  just need you! 

Help me take my fight for working families to Congress: linktr.ee/villegasforc...

The Dream & Promise Act discharge petition is ONE signature away from forcing a vote on a pathway to citizenship for DACA & TPS recipients.

Over 1/4 of CA-22 is made up of immigrants who deserve a fair shot. Yet once again, Valadao is nowhere to be found.

There's 4 weeks before ballots arrive by mail & about 8 weeks to the election. As a corporate-free candidate, I can't win this race without you. If you believe in fighting for a government that works for working people, join me by volunteering or donating: linktr.ee/villegasforc...

Election day is weeks away—yet my opponent David Valadao has not accepted a single opportunity to debate me. 🤷🏾‍♂️

Our district deserves the opportunity to hear why he turned back on his promise not to cut Medicaid.

Celebrate with us this Friday the 11th! Help us break in our brand new campaign headquarters + canvass to get out the vote. Oh, & did we mention an aguas frescas competition? 👀 

RSVP here: www.mobilize.us/randyvillega...

This Labor Day, I honor the labor movement that fought for the rights we have today, and the Central Valley workers who keep our communities running. I’m proud to stand with working people and honored to have labor by my side in this fight.
Corruption is undermining our democracy and rigging our government against working people. That's why I'm fighting corruption in Washington.

I'm running to support small businesses, because I know what it's like. That's why I'm not taking any donations from corporations. I'm fighting for the local shops of my community run by my neighbors, not the billionaire CEOs who buy our politicians.
I'm running to lower costs for people like you and me, and we can do that by making sure that billionaires pay their fair share.

Sikh communities are essential to the Central Valley. I am disgusted by the hateful xenophobic message of the DHS. No one should be stereotyped because of their name, faith, or the color of their skin. 

Our Sikh neighbors deserve dignity, respect, & better from their government.

Today marks 25 years since the horrific September 11th terrorist attacks. We remember and honor the lost lives of countless victims and heroes. May we honor their memory as a nation by moving forward with compassion, resilience, and courage. #NeverForget
Shanah Tovah to everyone celebrating Rosh Hashanah! 🍎🍯 May this new year bring you and your loved ones health, happiness, peace, and countless moments of joy.

Trump forcing DHS officers to break the law in an attempt to rig our elections is the biggest threat to our country.

We are a Democracy where our citizens have a right to vote that must be protected. Trump can't cheat his way around this. 

www.c-span.org/program/publ...

AI is advancing faster than our laws can keep up, putting our workers, environment, and children at risk. Congress must act now to regulate AI and ensure innovation never comes at the expense of our jobs, safety, or future. www.cnn.com/2026/09/14/u...
From housing to gas to groceries, everything is more expensive than ever. I'm running for Congress to fight to bring down costs for working families.

I'm so grateful for everyone who showed up to our campaign launch! As corporate-free candidate, it's you all who power this movement. I am committed to showing up for you in Congress the way you've shown up for me.

As a proud union member, I’m honored to receive the endorsement of @seiuca.org . Working people in the Central Valley are struggling with high costs & a lack of resources. In Congress, I’ll fight to reverse Valadao’s cuts & will prioritize investing in our working families.

Over a month ago I challenged David Valadao to a series of debates so he could finally face his constituents after turning his back on us to give tax breaks to billionaires. 

Today, he accepted part of my challenge. 

I’ll see him on the debate stage with @kgetnews.bsky.social on October 6.
Central Valley voters are tired of scraping by to make ends meet. We need a leader in Congress who will fight relentlessly for working families, not billionaires. www.latimes.com/politics/sto...

In the richest country in the world, no one should have to fight cancer and their Congressmember at the same time.

Stop by the campaign office nearest you to grab your yard sign while supplies last!
www.mobilize.us/randyvillega
I'm proud to have the endorsement of U.S. Senator @warren.senate.gov and look forward to joining her in Congress to fight for working families.

In one week, David Valadao will finally show up to debate me on stage with @kgetnews.bsky.social where we will hold him accountable for breaking his promise to protect Medicaid and choosing to help billionaires. Join us at the watch party www.mobilize.us/randyvillega...
People in the Central Valley are fed up with higher healthcare costs, skyrocketing housing prices, and more expensive gas and groceries at the hands of David Valadao’s failed leadership.
Ballots are coming! Help us reach voters by joining us on the doors or on the phone. www.mobilize.us/randyvillega
Ballots are coming soon. Are you ready?

Still buzzing from Sunday’s rally. I’m so grateful for the support of my community & the incredible leaders in this movement. I’m carrying that energy into tonight’s debate, keeping our community first and fighting for what matters most to the people of the Central Valley.
We need leaders who are going to uphold their oath to protect Americans.
My opponent voted to triple ICE's budget with no accountability for ICE agents that have targeted our communities.
It’s shameful that Valadao refuses to stand up for our immigrant communities.

I’m a son of the Central Valley, and tonight I told our stories and made it clear that I’m going to finally fight to bring down costs, restore the healthcare Valadao ripped away, and protect our working families.
Ballots are here, join us on the doors or on the phones. Let's win this.  www.mobilize.us/randyvillega

Las familias del valle merecen un gobierno que los cuide. Acompáñame en una reunión pública en Arvin para escuchar mi plan para hacer precisamente eso. Se acabó el aprovecharse del sufrimiento de nuestras familias. Regístrese para recibir la dirección www.mobilize.us/randyvillega...

Today I held a press conference calling on Congress to immediately suspend the federal gas & diesel tax. 

We must lower costs & give working families some relief at the pump.

As the son of Mexican immigrants, I know firsthand how terrifying reports of masked federal agents in unmarked cars can be for our families here in the Valley. Please know your rights & contact a rapid response network when you see ICE in our communities.
faithinthevalley.org
It's officially voting season  🍂 It's time to get out the vote, join us! www.mobilize.us/randyvillega

Farmworkers in the Valley feed our state and the rest of the world. David Valadao said, "it is what it is" when asked about ICE raiding the Valley. I think that's shameful. In Congress, I'll fight for a path to citizenship for our farm workers.

Ballots are here and our volunteers are working hard to get out the vote across the Central Valley. A special thank you to @californialabor.bsky.social for joining us today. This movement is by workers and for workers. Let's win this.

Earlier this week I joined the community of Arvin for a town hall to discuss lowering costs & protecting families. I was moved by the support I received & share the concerns around ICE in our neighborhoods. This conversation left me even more motivated to take our fight to Congress.

Meet me on the field to learn about my campaign for Congress! ⚽  I'm running to support working families in the Central Valley by lowering costs and standing up to ICE. Wear your costume and sign up at www.mobilize.us/randyvillega...
